news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a constructive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, reaching alignment on the planned NDA submission strategy and content. The company remains on track to file its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: ABVX Stock Eyes Over Six-Month High As Investors Double Down On Abivax's Lead Drug Bet – Buyout Chatter Builds
news.summary: Abivax shares approached a six-month high as Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $180 from $132, and recurring Big Pharma takeover speculation continued alongside growing analyst confidence in obefazimod's commercial prospects.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four senior commercial executives covering marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access, bolstering its organization ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA submission and potential US launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel said the newly raised $920 million gives Abivax the option to pursue a standalone US commercialization of obefazimod for ulcerative colitis rather than needing to sell the company to a larger pharma partner.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Full Exercise of Underwriters' Option to Purchase Additional ADSs, Bringing Gross Proceeds of Offering to $920M (€807M)
news.summary: Underwriters fully exercised their option to purchase 960,000 additional ADSs, taking total gross proceeds of Abivax's upsized offering to about $920 million, intended to fund US commercialization and R&D for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.

news.headline: New drug data makes this French biotech stock a buy, says Jefferies
news.summary: Jefferies analyst Faisal Khurshid upgraded Abivax to Buy from Hold and raised his price target to $158 from $108 after new obefazimod data showed malignancy rates in line with expected background levels for ulcerative colitis patients, easing prior safety concerns.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA on July 30, 2026 that aligned on submission strategy and content.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Abivax intends to file a MAA with the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, building on the positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and maintenance results already reported.

catalysts.when: ~September 2026 (mid-to-late month; exact date varies by source)
catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results / business update
catalysts.detail: Half-year 2026 results are expected to include an updated cash runway following the $920M ADS offering and progress toward the year-end NDA filing.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease; company guidance shifted the expected readout from late 2026 to mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval and US commercial launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Following the targeted Q4 2026 NDA submission, standard FDA review would put a potential approval/launch decision in 2027; Abivax has already begun building out a US commercial organization (four senior hires announced July 23, 2026) to support a solo launch.

pulse: Abivax enters mid-August 2026 on strong momentum: positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data, an encouraging FDA pre-NDA meeting (July 30), and a fully-subscribed $920 million ADS offering have funded a solo US commercialization push for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, with a first NDA targeted for Q4 2026. The stock trades near multi-month highs on bullish analyst upgrades (Morgan Stanley $180 PT, Jefferies upgrade to Buy) even as recurring Big Pharma takeover speculation (Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca) continues to swirl around the name. Near-term watch items are the H1 2026 financial update (September) and continued progress toward the year-end NDA filing, while the Crohn's disease Phase 2b readout has slipped from late 2026 to mid-2027.
